values.note: Campspot sells 33 RV sites: 15 20-amp electric sites (to 40 ft), 7 30/50-amp sites (to 40 ft), 7 full hook-up sites (5 pull-through and a corner deluxe pull-through, to 60-75 ft, and one back-in to 75 ft) and 4 rustic no-electric RV sites (to 40 ft), plus 3 electric tent sites, 4 rustic tent sites, a bell tent, a cottage and a retro trailer. Seasonal sites are separate (seasonal campers go through a background check).

values.note: Book on Campspot through the park's 'Book Now' link; the person booking must be at least 21. Two-night minimum in the cabin, retro trailer and safari tent only.
